subject: Overlaying a subset of the data

messages.author: fb4947fdab48d01a
messages.subject: Overlaying a subset of the data
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I'm trying to overlay just a portion of the data… An example is shown below:

## w/o overlay
mydat = data.frame(y=rnorm(1000), g=sample(0:1, 1000, rep=T), x=factor(sample(10, 1000, rep=T)))
ggplot(mydat, aes(x, y)) + geom_violin()

## overlaying all data
ggplot(mydat, aes(x, y)) + geom_violin() + geom_jitter()

How do I create a similar plot like the last one where only the points for which g==1 are added via jitter?

Thanks a ton,

benilton

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Overlaying a subset of the data
parts:
Hi Benilton,

You can override the default data.frame, like this:

ggplot(mydat, aes(x, y)) + geom_violin() + geom_jitter(data=subset(mydat, g==1))

Best,
Ista
